title: Structure-Aware Image Segmentation with Homotopy Warping
mechanism: Warp the prediction homotopically toward the label and penalise only the critical pixels whose flip changes topology.
adaptation: A jittered but topologically equal prediction adds no extra loss, which fits our labels. Crack class only. CPU warping cost over 20k steps needs a profile first.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + warping loss (crack), 3 seeds. Baseline: PF. Metric: component recall and crack IoU. Kill if no component recall gain >= 0.02.
evidence: R (TopoMortar): CrackTree Dice 0.77 vs 0.78 CEDice. beta0 46 vs 52 under Adele, no gain in supervised training.

alt_notes.adaptation: A jittered but topologically equal crack prediction gets no extra loss, which suits our labels; apply to crack with CE + Dice. CPU warping per batch is the cost concern at 20k steps.
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF + warping loss vs PF, 5 seeds. Kill if relF1@2 gain < 0.01.
